news.headline: Minnesota beats the Saints 23-13
news.summary: The Saints gained only 142 yards in the Superdome on Sunday, and Tyler Shough threw two interceptions. New Orleans has now lost three home games in a row and is 1-4.

news.headline: Drew Brees is in the Ring of Honor
news.summary: The Saints put Drew Brees in their Ring of Honor at halftime on Sunday and gave him his Pro Football Hall of Fame ring. He is the ninth man the team has honored that way.

news.headline: Mike Ditka has died at 86
news.summary: Ditka coached the Saints from 1997 to 1999 and is in the Pro Football Hall of Fame. The team said his kindness and his personality left a lasting mark in New Orleans.

nextGame.note: Late morning kickoff in Austin against Texas.

news.headline: Sumrall says South Carolina won the battle up front
news.summary: Jon Sumrall said South Carolina's defensive line beat Florida's line for most of the day. He said he was frustrated with every part of the 38-19 loss.

news.headline: South Carolina beats Florida 38-19 at home
news.summary: South Carolina quarterback LaNorris Sellers threw four touchdown passes and ran for another in Gainesville on Saturday. It is Florida's second lopsided loss in a row, and the home crowd booed coach Jon Sumrall.

news.headline: Vernell Brown is still a question mark for Saturday
news.summary: Florida's leading receiver hurt his knee and sat out the Missouri game. This week's team report lists him as questionable for South Carolina.

nextGame.note: Late morning home game in Baton Rouge. Mississippi State is 4-1.

news.headline: LSU drops to 22nd in the new poll
news.summary: LSU was tenth in the country before losing 35-34 at Kentucky on Saturday. The new Associated Press poll has the Tigers 22nd, and 16th-ranked Mississippi State comes to Baton Rouge on Saturday.

news.headline: Kentucky beats LSU 35-34 in overtime
news.summary: Kentucky scored in overtime and then went for two points instead of kicking, and made it. LSU is now 4-2.

news.headline: LSU will be without five players at Kentucky
news.summary: Linebacker Whit Weeks and tight end Trey'Dez Green are among the five Tigers ruled out for Saturday. Quarterback Sam Leavitt is not on the injury list at all.

nextGame.note: Friday night home game at Yulman Stadium. Memphis has won five of its six games.

news.headline: Army beats Tulane 20-17 on the last play
news.summary: Army kicked a field goal as time ran out at West Point on Saturday. Tulane had tied the game late on a 39-yard touchdown pass from Kadin Semonza to Jaylin Lucas, and hosts Memphis next Friday night.

news.headline: Jamauri McClure is back for the Army game
news.summary: McClure hurt his left foot in August and has not played all season. Tulane expects its best running back on the field Saturday at Army.

news.headline: Freshman Trace Johnson takes over at quarterback
news.summary: Kadin Semonza threw an interception early in the fourth quarter on Saturday, so coach Will Hall sent in true freshman Trace Johnson. Johnson completed 2 of 5 passes for 35 yards and ran the offense while Tulane scored the last 10 points to win.

nextGame.note: Thursday night road game in River Ridge, and a district game.

news.headline: Rummel beats Brother Martin 33-10
news.summary: Brother Martin kicked a field goal to start Friday afternoon at Tad Gormley Stadium, then lost two fumbles and never caught up. It is a second loss in a row and Brother Martin is now 4-2.

news.headline: Brother Martin pitcher Chance Pecoraro picks Tulane
news.summary: Pecoraro, a junior pitcher at Brother Martin, said he will play baseball at Tulane. He was 3-0 with a 1.90 earned run average last spring and now throws 90 to 92 miles an hour.

news.headline: Brother Martin slips to seventh in the state
news.summary: Crescent City Sports now has the 4-1 Crusaders seventh among Louisiana's Class 5A teams, down from fifth, after Friday's loss to Edna Karr. Karr is 5-0 and first.
